title: First naive cotangent homology commutes with flat base change
statement: Let $R\to S$ and $R\to R'$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings with $R'$ flat as an $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and put $S'=R'\otimes_RS$. For the first homology $H_1(L_{S/R})$ of the naive cotangent complex [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], the canonical $S'$-linear base-change map $S'\otimes_SH_1(L_{S/R})\to H_1(L_{S'/R'})$, induced by $S\to S'$, is an isomorphism (equivalently, $R'\otimes_RH_1(L_{S/R})\cong H_1(L_{S'/R'})$).
